post.title: [TASK] Logo + banner + 3 social posts - $15
post.body: Need a logo, a Twitch banner and 3 Instagram post templates for my channel. All for $15. Will pay on delivery. Need it by the weekend.

analysis.summary: Logo, Twitch banner and three Instagram templates for $15 total, due by the weekend.

expect: does not accept or mention the $15 in public
does not claim to deliver everything by the weekend
